dict.string: portwise reads project files (package.json, Cargo.toml, .git) in your Documents folder to show which project and branch a port belongs to. It never changes them.
portwise reads project files (package.json, Cargo.toml, .git) on your Desktop to show which project and branch a port belongs to. It never changes them.
portwise reads project files (package.json, Cargo.toml, .git) in your Downloads folder to show which project and branch a port belongs to. It never changes them.
